title: Slumberbound
description: this mod adds a new dimension when you sleep called the Dream Dimension
body:
“Drift beyond reality — and into the realm of dreams.”

Slumberbound turns sleep into an adventure.
When you go to bed at night, you don’t just skip to morning — you enter the Dream Realm, a tranquil, pastel world suspended between light and shadow.

Time flows differently here: when your dream fades, you’ll awaken back in the Overworld — sometimes blessed, sometimes cursed by what your mind touched in slumber.

Features

Dream Travel: Sleeping at night teleports you to the Dream Realm.

Custom Dimension: Floating islands, pastel fog, endless skies.

Dream Timer: Stay for a limited time before waking.

Lore

Legends whisper that dreams are doorways — fragments of another world where reality bends and thought takes shape. Few remember what they see there... and fewer still return unchanged.

Planned Additions

Dream biomes and flora

Dream creatures and spirits

 Effects tied for when you wake up
